declarations.doc: The pure-gauge electromagnetic potential `A^μ = ∂^μ χ = η^{μν} ∂_ν χ` built from a gauge function `χ`. The metric-contracted form `∑ κ, η μ κ * ∂_ κ χ` is the definition; the diagonal form (which equals `η μ μ * ∂_ μ χ` since `η` is diagonal) is derived in `ofGradient_apply`.

lemma toFieldStrength_ofGradient {d} {χ : SpaceTime d → ℝ} (hχ : ContDiff ℝ 2 χ)
    (x : SpaceTime d) : (ofGradient χ).toFieldStrength x = 0

declarations.doc: The `(inl 0, inr i)` component of the field strength tensor of the bare-gradient potential `B^μ := ∂_μ χ` for `χ(x) = x⁰·xⁱ` equals `2`. This witnesses that the bare covariant gradient does not produce a gauge-invariant field strength, so the raised-index contraction `η^{μν} ∂_ν χ` in `ofGradient` is necessary (see the module overview).

declarations.doc: Shifting by the zero gauge function is the identity.
declarations.signature:
lemma gaugeTransform_zero {d} (A : ElectromagneticPotential d) :
    gaugeTransform (0 : SpaceTime d → ℝ) A = A

declarations.doc: Two successive gauge shifts compose: shifting by χ₂ then χ₁ equals shifting by χ₁ + χ₂. This upgrades one-step F-invariance to invariance along any finite chain of gauge shifts.
declarations.signature:
lemma gaugeTransform_gaugeTransform {d} (A : ElectromagneticPotential d)
    (χ₁ χ₂ : SpaceTime d → ℝ) (hχ₁ : Differentiable ℝ χ₁) (hχ₂ : Differentiable ℝ χ₂) :
    gaugeTransform χ₁ (gaugeTransform χ₂ A) = gaugeTransform (χ₁ + χ₂) A

declarations.doc: `ofGradient` is additive in the gauge function (when both summands are differentiable).
The pure-gauge potential built from the zero gauge function has all components zero.
declarations.signature:
lemma ofGradient_zero {d} (x : SpaceTime d) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ofGradient (0 : SpaceTime d → ℝ) x μ = 0

declarations.doc: `ofGradient` intertwines the Lorentz action on potentials with composition by Λ⁻¹ on the gauge function: `Λ • ofGradient χ = ofGradient (χ ∘ (Λ⁻¹ • ·))`.

lemma ofGradient_equivariant {d} (χ : SpaceTime d → ℝ) (hχ : Differentiable ℝ χ)
    (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    Λ • ofGradient χ = ofGradient (χ ∘ (Λ⁻¹ • ·))

declarations.doc: Gauge transformations commute with Lorentz transformations: applying Λ and then performing a gauge transformation by `χ` equals performing a gauge transformation by `χ ∘ (Λ⁻¹ • ·)` and then applying Λ.
declarations.signature:
lemma gaugeTransform_equivariant {d} (A : ElectromagneticPotential d)
    (χ : SpaceTime d → ℝ) (hχ : Differentiable ℝ χ) (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    Λ • gaugeTransform χ A = gaugeTransform (χ ∘ (Λ⁻¹ • ·)) (Λ • A)

declarations.doc: Local gauge data. A gauge group `G₀` with Lie algebra `𝔤`, its group of jets `GJ` with Lie algebra of jets `𝔤J`, evaluation at the base point, formal derivatives, the adjoint action and the Maurer–Cartan form, subject to the identities used by the transformation laws of gauge and matter fields.
declarations.signature:
structure LocalGaugeData (G₀ : Type) [Group G₀] (𝔤 : Type) [LieRing 𝔤] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤]
    (GJ : Type) [Group GJ] (𝔤J : Type) [LieRing 𝔤J] [LieAlgebra ℝ 𝔤J] where
  eval : GJ →* G₀
  ofConstant : G₀ →* GJ
  eval_ofConstant : ∀ g, ev…

declarations.doc: Every global gauge transformation is the value of a jet, namely its constant jet.
declarations.signature: lemma eval_surjective : Function.Surjective jets.eval
lemma ofConstant_injective : Function.Injective jets.ofConstant
lemma evalLie_surjective : Function.Surjective jets.evalLie
lemma ofConstantLie_injective : Function.Injective jets.ofConstantLie

lemma adjoint_bracket (g : G₀) (a b : 𝔤) :
    jets.adjoint g ⁅a, b⁆ = ⁅jets.adjoint g a, jets.adjoint g b⁆

lemma deriv_adjointJ_ofConstant (g : G₀) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (x : 𝔤J) :
    jets.deriv μ (jets.adjointJ (jets.ofConstant g) x) =
      jets.adjointJ (jets.ofConstant g) (jets.deriv μ x)

declarations.doc: The iterated formal derivative on the jet Lie algebra.
declarations.signature: noncomputable def iteratedDeriv (μs : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) : 𝔤J →ₗ[ℝ] 𝔤J
lemma iteratedDeriv_zero : jets.iteratedDeriv (0 : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = LinearMap.id

lemma iteratedDeriv_cons (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (μs : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv (μ ::ₘ μs) = (jets.deriv μ).comp (jets.iteratedDeriv μs)

declarations.doc: The iterated derivative is additive in the multiset.
declarations.signature:
lemma iteratedDeriv_add (s t : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv (s + t) = (jets.iteratedDeriv s).comp (jets.iteratedDeriv t)

lemma iteratedDeriv_singleton (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv ({μ} : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) = jets.deriv μ

declarations.doc: The iterated Leibniz rule for the bracket.
declarations.signature:
lemma iteratedDeriv_bracket (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a b : 𝔤J) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv s ⁅a, b⁆ =
      (s.antidiagonal.map fun p =>
        ⁅jets.iteratedDeriv p.1 a, jets.iteratedDeriv p.2 b⁆).sum

lemma iteratedDeriv_ofConstantLie_of_ne_zero {p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (a : 𝔤) : jets.iteratedDeriv p (jets.ofConstantLie a) = 0

lemma iteratedDeriv_adjointJ_ofConstant (g : G₀) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (x : 𝔤J) :
    jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.adjointJ (jets.ofConstant g) x) =
      jets.adjointJ (jets.ofConstant g) (jets.iteratedDeriv s x)

lemma evalLie_iteratedDeriv_mulCoord (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J) :
    jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv s (jets.mulCoord μ a)) =
      s.count μ • jets.evalLie (jets.iteratedDeriv (s.erase μ) a)

  groupJ : GJ →* GJ'
  eval_groupJ : ∀ U, jets'.eval (groupJ U) = group (jets.eval U)
  groupJ_ofConstant : ∀ g, groupJ …

declarations.doc: A morphism intertwines the adjoint actions of the gauge groups.
declarations.signature:
lemma lie_adjoint (g : G₀) (x : 𝔤) :
    f.lie (jets.adjoint g x) = jets'.adjoint (f.group g) (f.lie x)

declarations.doc: A morphism commutes with iterated derivatives.
declarations.signature:
lemma lieJ_iteratedDeriv (s : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : 𝔤J) :
    f.lieJ (jets.iteratedDeriv s a) = jets'.iteratedDeriv s (f.lieJ a)
